verdict.summary: cartservice was redeployed onto a hotfix image at 09:43:52, and the restarted artifact fails GetCart calls, which propagates as errors through checkoutservice and frontend.
verdict.reasoning: checkoutservice's error ratio rose ~17x with a change point at 09:45:15 (tr_7387ab4e248b), just after cartservice's process shutdown at 09:43:51 (tr_11d793f2071f) and the image reference update at 09:43:52 (tr_383b9e40b543). Every failing trace terminates in an erroring, sub-5ms checkoutservice->CartService/GetCart span (tr_e7692a561d9f): fast failures, not waiting, which rules out dependency latency. The frontend and loadgenerator alerts are downstream consequences of the same call path. Earlier same-day traffic-shaping and REDIS_ADDR experiments were each reverted well before onset; the only change still standing at onset is the hotfix image, which was never reverted this time.
open_questions: The cartservice logs returned no post-restart error lines (the window was truncated), so the specific failure mode inside the new image is unconfirmed.
Whether the hotfix image itself is broken or whether it merely lacks configuration the previous artifact had.
Whether redis-cart is healthy independently of cartservice.
